mapper.select: SELECT a.id,a.owner_id,a.session_id,a.question_id,a.version_number, a.answer_condition AS `condition`,a.assistance_event_sequence,a.exposure_json,a.created_at, SHA2(a.content_json,256) AS content_hash, JSON_OBJECT('rootType',JSON_TYPE(a.content_json), 'textType',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.text')), 'diagramType',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram')), 'nodesType',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes')), 'nodeCount',JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes')), 'references',COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'type',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].reference'))), 'kind',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].reference.kind')), 'itemId',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].reference.itemId')), 'versionId',JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].reference.versionId')))) FROM JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes'))='ARRAY' THEN JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,'$.diagram.nodes') ELSE JSON_ARRAY() END, '$[*]' COLUMNS(position_index FOR ORDINALITY)) AS n WHERE JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].reference')) IS NOT NULL AND JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.content_json,CONCAT('$.diagram.nodes[',n.position_index-1,'].reference')))<>'NULL' ),JSON_ARRAY())) AS references_json FROM training_answer a WHERE a.owner_id=#{owner} AND a.id IN #{id}

SELECT q.id,q.owner_id,q.session_id,q.source_question_id,q.source_version_id,q.question_kind, JSON_OBJECT('rootType',JSON_TYPE(q.snapshot_json), 'contentType',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content')), 'sourceQuestionId',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.sourceQuestionId'), 'sourceVersionId',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.sourceVersionId'), 'title',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.title'), 'topicIds',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.topicIds'), 'dimensions',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.dimensions'), 'knowledgeLinks',JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.knowledgeLinks'), 'technologyType',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology')), 'scenarioType',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario')), 'conditionsType',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions')), 'technology',REGEXP_LIKE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.technology')),'[^[:space:]]'), 'scenario',REGEXP_LIKE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.scenario')),'[^[:space:]]'), 'conditions',REGEXP_LIKE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(q.snapshot_json,'$.content.conditions')),'[^[:space:]]')) AS metadata_json, s.id AS parent_session_id,s.owner_id AS session_owner_id,s.mode,s.generation, JSON_OBJECT('rootType',JSON_TYPE(s.context_json), 'references',COALESCE(( SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT( 'type',JSON_TYPE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.context_json,CONCAT('$[',c.position_index-1,']'))), 'kind',JSON_EXTRACT(s.context_json,CONCAT('$[',c.position_index-1,'].kind')), 'itemId',JSON_EXTRACT(s.context_json,CONCAT('$[',c.position_index-1,'].itemId')), 'versionId',JSON_EXTRACT(s.context_json,CONCAT('$[',c.position_index-1,'].versionId')))) FROM JSON_TABLE(CASE WHEN JSON_TYPE(s.context_json)='ARRAY' THEN s.context_json ELSE JSON_ARRAY() END, '$[*]' COLUMNS(position_index FOR ORDINALITY)) AS c ),JSON_ARRAY())) AS context_json, r.id AS repractice_id,r.question_mode AS repractice_question_mode,r.baseline_kind AS repractice_baseline_kind, b.id AS source_head_id,b.status AS source_status,b.current_version_id AS source_current_version_id, bv.id AS source_fixed_version_id,bc.id AS source_current_version_exists_id FROM training_question q LEFT JOIN training_session s ON s.owner_id=q.owner_id AND s.id=q.session_id LEFT JOIN review_repractice r ON r.owner_id=q.owner_id AND r.session_id=q.session_id LEFT JOIN question b ON b.owner_id=q.owner_id AND b.id=q.source_question_id LEFT JOIN question_version bv ON bv.owner_id=q.owner_id AND bv.question_id=q.source_question_id AND bv.id=q.source_version_id LEFT JOIN question_version bc ON bc.owner_id=b.owner_id AND bc.question_id=b.id AND bc.id=b.current_version_id WHERE q.owner_id=#{owner} AND q.session_id=#{sessionId} AND q.id=#{questionId}
